review_text: The sound quality on these headphones is truly mind-blowing! Deep punchy bass and crystal clear highs. Battery life lasts well over 35 hours.
Completely disappointed. The earcups broke within two weeks and the Bluetooth connection keeps dropping every five minutes.
Great active noise cancellation for the price. The build quality feels sturdy, though the headband is slightly tight for long sessions.
Incredible performance! The cooling system keeps temperatures low even during intensive 4K gaming. Keyboard RGB is gorgeous.
Overheats like crazy when running simple rendering tasks. The fan noise is loud enough to wake up neighbors. Poor battery life.
Decent display and fast SSD, but the trackpad feels mushy and customer support was completely unhelpful when asked about RAM upgrades.
Outstanding battery life! Lasts 12 full days on a single charge. The AMOLED screen is bright under direct sunlight and step tracking is accurate.
Heart rate sensor fluctuates wildly during workouts. The companion mobile app constantly crashes on Android.
Sleek design, comfortable silicone strap. Sleep tracking is very helpful. Wish it had NFC payments, but otherwise solid value.
Packs massive volume in a compact size! Water resistant design was tested at the beach and survived splashes effortlessly. Highly recommended.
Terrible distortion at volumes above 60%. Battery drains from 100% to zero in less than two hours. Waste of money.
Average sound profile. Good for background podcast listening, but lacks low-end bass response. Charging is somewhat slow.
Vibrant colors with 99% sRGB coverage! Crisp 4K resolution makes coding and photo editing a pure joy. USB-C hub is super convenient.
Arrived with 3 dead pixels right in the center! Severe backlight bleeding in dark rooms. Returning for refund.
Excellent panel clarity and smooth refresh rate. The built-in speakers are tinny, but paired with external speakers it is fantastic.
Satisfying tactile feedback from the hot-swappable switches! Heavy aluminum frame prevents desk sliding. Typing on this is addictive.
Defective spacebar that registers double presses constantly. Keycaps feel like cheap ABS plastic. Horrible quality control.
Very satisfying typing feel. Key lighting options are extensive. A bit bulky for travel, but great home office keyboard.
Tiny form factor yet charges both my laptop and phone simultaneously at full speed! Doesn't heat up at all. Essential travel companion.
Stopped working after just three days with a burnt electrical smell. Dangerous product that could have fried my laptop.
Sharp OLED display makes streaming movies breathtaking. Stylus response has negligible latency for note taking. Battery life is solid 10 hours.
Software optimization is awful. Jittery scrolling and multi-tasking stutters frequently. Cameras take grainy low-light photos.
Best value tablet on the market! Fast processor, sleek aluminum chassis, and loud quad speakers.
Flawless fit that stays put during intense running. Touch controls are responsive and call microphone quality is crystal clear.
Left earbud died within three weeks. Charging case lid feels flimsy and loose. Completely regret this purchase.
